issues.title: Busy cursor on export
issues.body:
The wargame that was played last Friday concentrated on developing a large number of messages, mostly using formatted templates.

Some of these templates have up to 20 fields, which translates to 20 columns in the export.

The analysts are exporting the wargame to XLS.  After the click on `Create Export` there is a ~5 second delay before the export appears.  This made it look like the `click` hadn't happened - so we did it several times, then saw several exports.

A busy cursor would have demonstrated that Serge was still processing the data.

So, the busy cursor should be shown as the export is handled.
